thread:
elaine_m: Heads-up: partner GatewayCo sent a nightly batch where every event was shifted by +1h (local->UTC mixup). Ledger applied duplicate credits to ~1.8k accounts. Need a safe mitigation.

omar_k: Is this a one-off or recurring?

elaine_m: They patched the gateway but the bad file already landed. Pattern: whole-file offset, not per-event drift.

sarah_pm: Short-term options? Pause ingest for them or quarantine rows?

raj_eng: Pause risky. Proposal: quarantine suspect rows into a "reserve" ledger state when event_time differs from upload_time by >15m. Add upload_uuid and file_seq parsing so idempotency is stronger.

omar_k: Also add nightly reconcile that attempts matches by event_hash, window+amount, or partner replay. Auto-apply if confidence >=95%, manual review if 50-95%.

marketplace-bot: deploybot: reconcile-reserve service created. Owner: @raj_eng. CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/teams/ingest/pipelines/reconcile-reserve/42

sarah_pm: I'll draft contract amendment requiring upload_uuid and 48h replay SLA, and partner-facing replay request templates.

elaine_m: I'll own ledger changes and a 7d auto-reverse policy if no replay. Raj owns the reconcile job. Omar will help with ops comms.

raj_eng: Dev plan: ingest header support, add reconcile_flag on usage rows, nightly matcher, metrics (reserve_count, auto_apply_rate). Target staging deploy EOD Fri.

omar_k: Add test fixtures for full-file offsets and replay flows. Ping #eng-oncall if blockers. :thumbsup:
